supersedes.reason: The v1 downloader delegated transfer to snapshot_download and therefore could not enforce the frozen zero-application-retry contract.

scientific_evidence_role: prospective acquisition contract only; no model, environment, service, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim

implementation.network_client: Python urllib.request, one sequential logical request per expected file, no application retry loop
implementation.nested_path_policy: Safe sorted relative POSIX paths are permitted; absolute paths, empty components, dot components, and parent traversal are rejected.

scheduler.start_condition: Wave1 controller is independently TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, all Wave1 services and evaluators have stopped, both target and evidence roots remain absent, and no process references either target.
scheduler.mac_to_server_transfer: If direct server download is unavailable, use only resumable SFTP limited to 4096 Kbit/s and preserve fresh recovery identities.

execution_contract.server_root_injection: Set AGENT_ENHANCE_REMOTE_ROOT to the approved high-capacity server project root named AgentEnhance immediately before execution.

acceptance: The scheduler start condition is independently observed before either command starts.
Only the exact sorted expected_files from each immutable-revision manifest are requested and materialized.
Every response is HTTPS status 200; redirect occurrence and final hostname are recorded without retaining signed URLs.
Every file matches its frozen byte size; file count and total bytes match each model row.
Every observed SHA-256 is retained in the model record and MODEL_SHA256SUMS.
Both evidence roots report zero retries, one logical request per file, TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, and no TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure: Any premature start, collision, unsafe path, timeout, HTTP error, non-HTTPS response, byte mismatch, file-set mismatch, or evidence mismatch seals the fresh evidence root as TERMINAL_REJECTED and retains the partial target. A recovery requires new roots and a separately frozen contract.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit both model records and inventories, then complete the frozen Hindsight wheelhouse and isolated-environment gates. Model acceptance does not authorize lifecycle or numerical execution.
prohibited_actions: executing the superseded v1 materialization contract
starting while Wave1 or any Wave1 service remains active
using snapshot_download, a moving revision, an implicit cache, or an application retry
loading a model or installing dependencies during acquisition
repairing, resuming, overwriting, or deleting a rejected target in place
populating a comparison-table numeric cell from model acquisition
